skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the principles, nature, and foundations of social insurance management, including the organizational structure of social insurance, management of participants and beneficiaries, and financial management.
Use knowledge of social insurance management to develop policies and strategies for the organizational structure of social insurance agencies.
Demonstrate the ability to synthesize, analyze, and think systematically, with the capacity to organize and manage resources for professional social insurance management activities.
Show initiative in independent work, take personal responsibility, and inspire team members in assigned tasks and social activities.
